:''This page is about the Devotion skill. For other uses, see [[Devotion (disambiguation)]].''

Devotion is arguably the personal hallmark of the [[Bloodsworn_Gods|Bloodsworn]] servants and arms the Priest and Paladin with many tools with which to fight the enemies of [[truth]] and [[righteousness]]. Through the power of their faith a priest may enact a holy inquisition to ensure that the enemies of Good are duly punished for their crimes.

Devotion also offers access to the holy rites, a large group of offensive and defensive tools that can not only offer visions of hell to their foe, pacify the chaotic, summon forth demons and dazzling light to torment their opponent, but can also revitalise allies, resurrect fellow believers, and swear the blood oath to create a powerful bond.

[[devotion (statistic)|Devotion]] is considered a resource and can be gained passively on a daily basis or by immolating the corpses of the fallen in the [[Flame of Yggdrasil]], snatching souls from the harrowing journey to the Finality.

The skill of '''Devotion''' is available to the [[Priest]] [[class]]. Priests also have the skills of [[Spirituality]] and [[Zeal]].

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Penitence
 |description=Condemn the unfaithful to eternal penance.
 |unique=Yes
 |lessons=267
 |syntax=PERFORM PENITENCE <target>
 |required=300 devotion and 100 mana
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=1.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=Through your piety, you are able to force an individual to perform penance for their crimes. Upon granting redemption to this person through death, your works will be rewarded with an increase in your Devotional energies.

When used against an adventurer, this will brand them and upon granting redemption to this person through death, your righteous work will be rewarded with an increase in your Devotional energies.

Against denizens, this will scour your foe in righteous fire, forcing them to take ten percent more damage from your mace(*) and the weaponmastery attacks of your fellow Paladins(**). In this case, the devotion cost of this holy art will be reduced but its equilibrium cost will be slightly increased.

* SPIRITUALITY SMITE.
** All weapon-based attacks in the WEAPONMASTERY skill when performed by a Paladin.
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Illuminate
 |description=Illuminate your path.

 |target=Room

 |detail=When you perform this ability, you will create an orb of light which will move off in the direction specified. The orb is unpredictable and will move erratically. Each time it moves, the orb will illuminate the room, giving a chance to strip the blackwind or astralform defences from adventurers in the room.<p>In addition, you may extinguish the orb at any time to travel directly to the room the orb is currently in.</p><p>It should be noted that the orb will only have enough energy to move a limited number of times, and it will fade if not extinguished a short while after it ceases moving.</p>

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Bloodsworn
 |description=Bond with another via a blood oath.
 |lessons=1736
 |syntax=BLOODSWEAR <priest or paladin><br>BLOODSWORN ON/OFF<br>BLOODSWORN REJECT
 |required=Bloodswear <target>: 1000 mana<br>Bloodswear on: 1000 mana, 5 mana per second drain
 |target=Adventurers and self
 |cooldown=Bloodswear on: 6.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=The bond of the bloodsworn is one of the most revered rituals of devotion-users. When a Priest and a Paladin feel strongly that they wish to become one, they bloodswear to each other, and from that moment on, have the capability to bond their very souls to each other. When the BLOODSWORN ON ritual is performed by both the Priest and the Paladin, their maximum health and manas will be 65% of the -sum- of both their normal maximum health and maximum mana respectively. Further, some portion of the health or mana healed by either the Priest or Paladin, when using elixirs of health or mana, will also be healed on his or her bloodsworn. The hands ability shall also heal an additional amount when performed on your bloodsworn.<p>The bloodsworn ability will automatically turn off if the Priest and Paladin are away from each other for greater than approximately 60 seconds.</p><p>As with many phenomena that grant great power unto the user, the power of the bloodsworn comes at a price. While the bloodsworn pact is activated, with BLOODSWORN ON, the mana of both the Priest and Paladin will drain away. Further, and far more seriously, if either dies while the ability is active, the other will be critically damaged in body. Such is the price of power.</p><p>If you wish to break your blood bond, you may do so by rejecting your bloodsworn, but be aware that you will not be able to become bloodsworn to another until the New Year.</p>
}}
